correctness.rationale: For dihedral quandle multiplication e_i*e_j=e_(2j-i), the auxiliary associative modular cyclic algebra U=k[t]/((t-1)^p) satisfies x*y=σ_{-1}(x)σ_2(y). An augmentation-zero idempotent lies in J, then J^2, J^4, and eventually J^p=0, hence is zero. On augmentation one, truncated Exp/Log are inverse since J^p=0 and denominators below p are units, converting the idempotent condition to (σ_{-1}+σ_2−I)z=0. The eigenspace basis v_r=Σ_i i^(−r)(t^i−1) has eigenvalues (−1)^r+2^r−1. Only odd r with ord_p(2)|(r−1) survive: precisely d=(p−1)/lcm(2,ord_p(2)) coordinates. On these σ_{-1}=−I and σ_2=2I, giving the full nonzero core-quandle x*y=−x+2y and exactly 1+q^d total finite-field idempotents. Edge p=3 and p=17 (290) follow; field k may be any char-p field.
